UWB Radar

Our Work

Featured Projects

AI, UAV

Research and Development of TinyML Techniques for UAV Applications with Intelligent Edge Processing and Multi-Sensor Fusion

The project focuses on deploying TinyML models for on-device Edge AI processing on resource-constrained UAV hardware, combined with Multi-Sensor Fusion. The research aims to enable UAVs to process and analyze data directly onboard, reducing dependence on external computing systems while supporting tasks such as flight-state recognition, image recognition, and real-time decision support. Through this approach, the project aims to develop intelligent, compact, and energy-efficient UAV systems suitable for practical applications.

2026 • In Progress View
AI

Research on viscoelastic imaging of soft tissues

The “Research on Viscoelastic Imaging of Soft Tissues” project focuses on developing imaging approaches to evaluate the mechanical characteristics of soft biological tissues, particularly their elastic and viscous behavior. By analyzing how tissues respond to mechanical deformation, the study aims to provide additional information beyond conventional structural imaging and support more quantitative tissue assessment. The project contributes to the development of non-invasive imaging methods with potential applications in biomedical research, tissue characterization, and future clinical diagnostic support.

2023 • View
Energy

Research, design and manufacture environmentally friendly agricultural-photovoltaic systems based on solar energy convergence technology

The “Research, Design and Manufacture Environmentally Friendly Agricultural-Photovoltaic Systems Based on Solar Energy Convergence Technology” project focuses on developing an integrated agricultural-photovoltaic system that combines solar power generation with agricultural production. The research covers system design, prototype development, and evaluation of solutions that improve land-use efficiency while supporting clean energy generation. The project aims to create a sustainable and environmentally friendly model for modern agriculture.
